author: Prefer Peace to Piece
text_post: This is light. I saw some Marilyn Monroe quotes from wiki. I couldn’t get the link to work so I just copied them. Imperfection is beauty, madness is genius and it’s better to be absolutely ridiculous than absolutely boring. Fear is stupid. So are regrets. If you can make a woman laugh, you can make her do anything. The real lover is the man who can thrill you by kissing your forehead or smiling into your eyes or just staring into space. I don’t mind living in a man’s world as long as I can be a woman in it. It’s better to be unhappy alone than unhappy with someone – so far. When it comes down to it. I let people think what they want. And if they care enough to bother with what I do, I already know I’m better than them. I am not interested in money. I just want to be wonderful. Give a girl the right pair of shoes and she’ll conquer the world. I restore myself when I’m alone. Hollywood is a place where they’ll pay you a thousand dollars for a kiss and fifty cents for your soul. I don’t know who invented high heels, but all women owe him a lot. If I’d observed all the rules, I’d never have got anywhere. A career is wonderful, but you can’t curl up with it on a cold night. No one ever told me I was pretty when I was a little girl. All little girls should be told they’re pretty, even if they aren’t. It’s not true I had nothing on, I had the radio on. The nicest thing for me is sleep, then at least I can dream. I am good, but not an angel. I do sin, but I am not the devil. I am just a small girl in a big world trying to find someone to love. Dogs never bite me. Just humans. Success makes so many people hate you. I wish it wasn’t that way. It would be wonderful to enjoy success without seeing envy in the eyes of those around you. It’s all make believe, isn’t it? Sex is a part of nature. I go along with nature. I knew I belonged to the public and to the world, not because I was talented or even beautiful, but because I had never belonged to anything or anyone else. I’m very definitely a woman and I enjoy it. What do I wear in bed? Why, Chanel No. 5, of course. I’ve been on a calendar, but never on time. I don’t mind making jokes, but I don’t want to look like one. It’s often just enough to be with someone. I don’t need to touch them. Not even talk. A feeling passes between you both. You’re not alone. Men are so willing to respect anything that bores them. The body is meant to be seen, not all covered up. I want to grow old without facelifts. I want to have the courage to be loyal to the face I have made. Before marriage, a girl has to make love to a man to hold him. After marriage, she has to hold him to make love to him. Husbands are chiefly good as lovers when they are betraying their wives. To put it bluntly, I seem to have a whole superstructure with no foundation. But I’m working on the foundation. I’ve often stood silent at a party for hours listening to my movie idols turn into dull and little people. I have feelings too. I am still human. All I want is to be loved, for myself and for my talent. A strong man doesn’t have to be dominant toward a woman. He doesn’t match his strength against a woman weak with love for him. He matches it against the world. A sex symbol becomes a thing. I hate being a thing. Being a sex symbol is a heavy load to carry, especially when one is tired, hurt and bewildered. Dreaming about being an actress, is more exciting then being one. An actress is not a machine, but they treat you like a machine. A money machine. Ever notice that what the hell is always the right decision? First, I’m trying to prove to myself that I’m a person. Then maybe I’ll convince myself that I’m an actress. I learned to walk as a baby and I haven’t had a lesson since. What good is it being Marilyn Monroe? Why can’t I just be an ordinary woman? A woman who can have a family … I’d settle for just one baby. My own baby. Fame will go by and, so long, I’ve had you, fame. If it goes by, I’ve always known it was fickle. So at least it’s something I experience, but that’s not where I live. I have too many fantasies to be a housewife. I guess I am a fantasy. The trouble with censors is that they worry if a girl has cleavage. They ought to worry if she hasn’t any. I read poetry to save time. If I’m a star, then the people made me a star. I guess I have always been deeply terrified to really be someone’s wife since I know from life one cannot love another, ever, really.
